its listing platform is one small part of a publishing business."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Telematics hardware and fleet tracking software for fleet operators, with no consumer marketplace or dealer advertising."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Content recommendation and native advertising technology for publishers and advertisers, not an automotive marketplace."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Business software and directory advertising for small local service firms, not car shoppers or automotive dealers."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Go-to-market B2B contact data and sales tools for sales teams, with no consumer marketplace or automotive customers."}]}
